structured.answer: I'm leaning towards the S&P 500 fund the page marks with a star as "הזול ביותר לתוכנית שלכם". That's "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" through פסגות, which comes to 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. The page's own pick, iShares through "אינטראקטיב ישראל", comes to 84,184 ₪, and the big banks like לאומי or הפועלים come to only about 68–71k because they take around 15k in fees. But that's for the page's numbers (10,000 now plus 500 a month), not my 30,000, so I wouldn't put money in today.

stuck.where: Top of the page, the inputs סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית
stuck.why: It's set to 10,000 ₪ and 500 a month, not my 30,000 ₪. So every big number I saw is for someone else's plan.
I put in 70,000 at 7% for 10 years, so I expected something like 70% more, and only 84k comes out. I didn't get why it's so low. Maybe that's the 'בכסף של היום' line, but I'm not sure.

stuck.where: Right-hand list of accounts, the פסגות row
stuck.why: Up top, פסגות is the starred cheapest (86,492), but in the account list it says 'אין נתון' with a long grey paragraph. I didn't know which one to believe.

stuck.where: Right-hand column: 'אינטראקטיב ישראל (מותג של MEXEM LTD)'
stuck.why: That's the page's default pick and I've never heard of it, so it made me hesitate.

stuck.why: About 20 funds with lots of coloured tags (צוברת, מחלקת דיבידנד, מנוטרלת מט"ח, נאמן...). They looked alike, so I stopped reading them.

findings.what: Too many options that look the same, each with 5–6 coloured tags full of terms I don't know. I'd rather do nothing than choose from those.
84,184 from 70,000 over 10 years at 7% looks wrong to me and nothing near it explains it
Minus numbers like −533 ₪ and −2.44% in the fund list look like losses and scare me off
Halfway down, a nav bar (מקור / מדריך / השקעה במדד...) suddenly covers the middle of the list
The page is very long, with a whole section on currency hedging I don't care about. By then I'd have closed it on the bus.
There's no clear button for what to do now, like open an account or buy
